description:
stt-final cloud option "speechmatics-batch:<model>": after Stop, send the recording's audio to the Speechmatics batch API for the final transcript + diarization, replacing local final STT.

- Implement the cloud final-provider interface from the pipeline dispatch ticket: build WAV from RecordingAudio, create job (diarization speaker, get_speakers when voice-id is selected), poll with backoff and cancellation (PostProcessor signal), fetch json-v2, normalize to FinalWord tokens + turns with a new providerRunId, same replacement semantics as local final STT (post-processor.ts deleteTokens by runId).
- Non-persisted audio mode: the job must be submitted before the ephemeral key is dropped; if submission fails the stage fails visibly rather than silently losing audio.
- Respect "post-processing yields to live capture" (kdl.14): uploading/polling is network, but don't decode large WAVs while capturing.
- Resolver: with live local and final Speechmatics batch, VAD stays for live; with live off, VAD is locked by the batch service.
- Reprocess offer in RecordingView works for this option.

Done when: a local-live recording gets a Speechmatics final transcript and speaker turns after Stop; failure leaves the live transcript intact.
title: Speechmatics batch final transcript
